clue.text: Bear and rodents endlessly symbolic

parts.note: to tote is to carry or bear

indicators.note: endlessly says the word for the rodents loses its final letter

parts.note: mice are small rodents

explanation.surface: A bear and some mice appear as emblems of something, perhaps on a crest.
explanation.definitionFit: Something emblematic, like a carved tribal pole figure, serves as a symbol of a clan or idea.

clue.text: Time to expect exercise

parts.note: to ask a price or effort is to expect or demand it

explanation.surface: It is time to expect some physical exertion.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece of work set for someone, like a school exercise, is an assignment.

clue.text: Rout distressed a reliable worker

indicators.note: distressed means the letters of rout are thrown into disarray

parts.note: per means a, as in five pounds per (a) head

explanation.surface: A defeat upset a dependable employee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distressed' turns ROUT into TROU; 'a' gives PER, as in so much a head.
explanation.definitionFit: A stalwart who keeps going without complaint, like a seasoned actor, is a dependable worker.

clue.text: Move quickly from second hill

parts.note: a mo is a moment or second
a tor is a rocky hill, as on Dartmoor

explanation.surface: Someone hurries away from a second hilltop.
explanation.walkthrough: A TOR is a rocky hilltop in the English West Country.
explanation.definitionFit: To drive along briskly, or travel fast, is to speed along.

clue.text: Tea, not elaborate for cleric

parts.note: cha is an informal British word for tea
plain means simple, not elaborate

explanation.surface: A simple cup of tea is served for the vicar.
explanation.definitionFit: A clergyman attached to a chapel, college or regiment is a cleric.

clue.text: Titled female companion protected by proper saints

indicators.note: protected by means the companion's letters sit inside the word for proper

parts.note: due means fitting or proper, as in due respect
CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British order

explanation.surface: A noblewoman with her companion is guarded by a band of holy saints.
explanation.walkthrough: CH is the post-nominal for a Companion of Honour, a British order.
explanation.definitionFit: A duke's wife holds a noble rank, so she is a woman with a title.

clue.text: Trick left people in prehistoric tomb

parts.note: to do someone is to cheat or trick them
men means people

explanation.surface: A con left people inside an ancient burial chamber.
explanation.definitionFit: A megalithic structure of upright stones topped by a slab marked an ancient grave.

clue.text: Mug supporting most of tradition concerning imprisonment

indicators.note: supporting means, in a down clue, the face word sits below the rest
most of drops the last letter of the word for tradition

parts.note: a custom is a tradition
dial is slang for the face, as is mug

explanation.surface: A cup holds up the remains of a ritual connected with jail.
explanation.definitionFit: A sentence involving detention in prison is described as relating to imprisonment.

clue.text: One finally obtained rent in action boosting self-esteem

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter of one

parts.note: got means obtained
a rent is a tear or rip

explanation.surface: A tenant finally gets the rent in, an act that feels good.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done chiefly to flatter one's own vanity raises one's self-regard.

clue.text: Mixing pack, separating spades and diamonds?

indicators.note: separating means the word for pack goes between the other two pieces

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for spades in card games
bling is slang for flashy jewellery such as diamonds
to cram is to pack tightly

explanation.surface: Shuffling a deck of cards keeps the spades apart from the diamonds.
explanation.walkthrough: The card surface misleads: diamonds here are jewels, slang BLING, not the suit.
explanation.definitionFit: Jumbling things together in confusion, as with eggs, is mixing them.

clue.text: Deficiency in disorderly host far ahead of lines

indicators.note: ahead of places the rearranged letters before those for lines
disorderly says the letters of host and far are put out of order

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for line, so LL is lines

explanation.surface: A chaotic host comes up short of what was needed well before the queue.
explanation.definitionFit: A shortage or amount by which something falls below what is needed is a deficiency.

clue.text: Love participating in games, but finally lost track

indicators.note: finally lost says the last letter of the combination is dropped
participating in puts the love letter inside the word for games

parts.note: sport means games in general
love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: A romantic player gets involved in sport but loses the plot at the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'participating in' gives SPOORT, and 'finally lost' takes off its last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Hunters follow the trail of droppings and footprints an animal leaves, its track.

clue.text: Figure, entirely in trim, with record to beat

indicators.note: in places the word for entirely inside the word for trim

parts.note: to pare is to trim
all means wholly or entirely
a log is a written record
to ram is to strike or beat

explanation.surface: Someone fully trim in figure is chasing a record to beat.
explanation.definitionFit: A four-sided geometric shape with opposite sides parallel is a figure in geometry.

clue.text: Bird getting agitated there was a rook

indicators.note: getting agitated says the letters are stirred up into a new order

parts.note: R is the chess abbreviation for rook

explanation.surface: A rook was there and someone got upset about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting agitated' rearranges THEREWAS plus A and R.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-winged seabird that skims low over the ocean is a type of bird.

clue.text: One parking on road in mess and distress

indicators.note: on means the following letters come after what precedes
in puts the road abbreviation inside the word for mess

parts.note: a hash is a mess, as in make a hash of it
I is the Roman numeral one
P is the abbreviation for parking, as on road signs

explanation.surface: A single driver parked on a road gets into a mess and is upset.
explanation.definitionFit: Severe suffering or privation is a state of distress.

clue.text: Signal from land embracing European plan

indicators.note: embracing means the word for land wraps around the other pieces

parts.note: the shore is the land at the edge of the sea
a map is a plan or chart

explanation.surface: A message is sent from the coast containing a European scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: A system of signalling with flags held in the arms is a visual signal.

clue.text: Get rid of inspector, mostly mean

parts.note: DI is a Detective Inspector

indicators.note: mostly means the word for mean loses its last letter

parts.note: to spell is to mean, as in this spells trouble

explanation.surface: Someone wants to be rid of a police inspector who is rather stingy.
explanation.definitionFit: To drive away doubts or fears is to get rid of them.

clue.text: Express disapproval over delay in middle of speech giving instruction

indicators.note: over means, in a down clue, the disapproval word sits above the rest

parts.note: tut is the sound of disapproval

indicators.note: in puts the delay word inside the centre letters of speech
middle of takes the central pair of letters from speech

parts.note: a lag is a delay

explanation.surface: A teacher clicks their tongue at a hesitation midway through a talk.
explanation.walkthrough: The middle of 'speech' is its central pair, EE.
explanation.definitionFit: Guardianship and teaching given by a tutor amounts to instruction.

clue.text: Was untrue menu missing regular items for part of year?

indicators.note: missing regular items says every other letter of these words is dropped, keeping the rest

explanation.surface: A dishonest menu left out the seasonal dishes it promised.
explanation.walkthrough: Drop the first, third, fifth letters and so on of WASUNTRUEMENU.
explanation.definitionFit: Fall, the season between summer and winter, is one part of the calendar.

clue.text: Romance? Crazy without acceptable gifts

parts.note: a romance is a story or tale

indicators.note: without says a letter is removed from the word for crazy

parts.note: nuts means crazy
U means socially acceptable, upper-class usage

explanation.surface: A wild love affair lacks the qualities that make one acceptable.
explanation.walkthrough: U for 'acceptable' comes from the old U and non-U distinction in British upper-class speech.
explanation.definitionFit: Natural abilities or aptitudes are often called gifts.

clue.text: Gather round and study site of battle

parts.note: to cull is to gather or pick out
O is round in shape
a den is a private study

explanation.surface: Collect yourself, look around and research the scene of a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: CULLODEN, near Inverness in Scotland, was where the Jacobites were defeated in 1746.
explanation.definitionFit: The moor near Inverness where the Jacobite army lost in 1746 is a famous battlefield.

clue.text: Resentment from dope receiving nothing after failure

indicators.note: after means the failure word comes first in the answer

parts.note: a dud is a failure

indicators.note: receiving means the information word takes in the zero letter

parts.note: dope and gen are both slang for information
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Bitterness comes from a fool who took nothing after a flop.
explanation.definitionFit: A state of indignant offence, as in going off in high dudgeon, is resentment.

clue.text: Confidence shown by religious group carrying on

indicators.note: carrying means the sect word holds the other piece inside

parts.note: a sect is a religious group
re means on or concerning

explanation.surface: Trust is shown by a cult that goes on regardless.
explanation.definitionFit: Something told in confidence is private information shared quietly.

clue.text: Join together to get hold of old album, book still in good condition

indicators.note: to get hold of means the word for join together grips the other pieces inside it

parts.note: to weld is to join metal together
an LP is a long-playing record, an old-style album
to book a seat is to reserve it

explanation.surface: Someone wants to snap up an old vinyl record and a book still in mint condition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something kept in fine shape despite its age is still in good condition.

clue.text: Look up against it with openers for India still in

indicators.note: in puts those first letters between the other pieces

parts.note: V for versus means against
taken as written

indicators.note: openers for takes the first letters of India and still

explanation.surface: Someone looks something up about cricket, with India's openers still batting.
explanation.walkthrough: The cricket picture misleads: 'openers' just means first letters, slotted between V and IT.
explanation.definitionFit: To look someone up is to call on them, pay a call.

clue.text: Declaration of hero having no effect

indicators.note: declaration of means the hero word is spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: an idol is a hero, someone worshipped

explanation.surface: A statement by a celebrity turns out to be futile.
explanation.definitionFit: An empty threat that is pointless and achieves nothing has no effect.

clue.text: Thanks to opening of nightclub, proceed to dance

parts.note: ta is an informal British thank you

indicators.note: opening of takes the first letter of nightclub

parts.note: to go is to proceed

explanation.surface: Thanks to the nightclub opening, people can go dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: To perform the Argentine ballroom dance is to dance in that style.

clue.text: Trade so involved with commercial anchorage

indicators.note: involved suggests the letters of trade so are tangled up into a new order

parts.note: an ad is a commercial, an advertisement

explanation.surface: Business and advertising combine at a harbour where ships load.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheltered stretch of water near shore where ships ride at anchor is an anchorage.

clue.text: Muscle in lean detail

indicators.note: in places the muscle word inside the word for lean

parts.note: to rest against something is to lean on it
a pec is a pectoral chest muscle

explanation.surface: A bodybuilder's lean muscle is described in fine detail.
explanation.definitionFit: A particular point or aspect, as in correct in every respect, is a detail.

clue.text: Understanding agent entering houses

indicators.note: houses means the words agent entering contain the answer within them

explanation.surface: An estate agent comes to an agreement when showing people round properties.
explanation.definitionFit: A friendly agreement between nations, like the 1904 Anglo-French one, is an understanding.
